This notice should be read with the Merchant Shipping (Crew Agreements, Lists of Crew and Discharge of Seamen) (Fishing Vessels) Regulations 1972 as amended..

Amendment 2 updates reference information only.

Annex B is also attached separately to this notice in a downloadable open document format.

Notice to

fishing vessel owners

operators and managers

employers of fishermen

skippers

officers and fishermen on fishing vessels.
